visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens with a close-up of a striped ceramic bowl filled with a beige-colored thick soup. A person's hand, partially visible, uses a black ladle to stir the creamy mixture, which has visible bits of ground mushrooms. At the top, bold white text overlays the scene against the plain indoor lighting. (2) Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves are shown holding a bright yellow corn cob. They meticulously pull away the fine silk strands. The camera then shifts to a medium close-up as the corn is broken in half and a pair of black-handled kitchen scissors is used to detach the kernels into a clear glass bowl. (3) The scene transitions to a black non-stick pan on a stove. Sliced white mushrooms are poured in from a bowl, followed by a drizzle of oil. A red and black spatula stirs the mushrooms until they begin to brown. Small diced white onions are then added and mixed thoroughly under bright studio lighting. (4) Various ingredients are added sequentially into the pan: diced orange carrots, the previously prepared corn kernels, and a sprinkle of dried green herbs. A container of white milk is poured in, followed by clear water. The liquid begins to simmer, and the background remains a neutral kitchen setting. (5) A glass lid with a blue rim is placed over the pot to trap steam. Later, a hand-held stick blender with a silver shaft and black handle is submerged into the cooked mixture, whirring as it purees the chunky ingredients into a smooth, thick, and consistent beige porridge-like texture. (6) The final creamy soup is ladled back into the striped bowl from the beginning. A few pinches of fresh green herbs are sprinkled on top as a garnish. The lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the texture of the finished low-calorie dish.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 低卡蘑菇玉米濃湯. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 玉米 (2 條) 鬍把它剝掉. (3) [Subtitle]: 把它折對半. (4) [Subtitle]: 剪刀朝著中心點刺進去. (5) [Subtitle]: 轉一圈就剝開了. (6) [Subtitle]: 沿著旁邊輕輕剝就下來了. (7) [Subtitle]: 準備一個湯鍋. (8) [Subtitle]: 蘑菇 10 朵. (9) [Subtitle]: 加少許的油. (10) [Subtitle]: 先把蘑菇炒香. (11) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥碎 100g. (12) [Subtitle]: 稍微拌炒一下. (13) [Subtitle]: 黑胡椒粉適量. (14) [Subtitle]: 放入紅蘿蔔 (10g)、玉米粒. (15) [Subtitle]: 義式綜合香料少許. (16) [Subtitle]: 牛奶 250ml. (17) [Subtitle]: 水適量. (18) [Subtitle]: 調它的濃稠度. (19) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋悶一下. (20) [Subtitle]: 小火煮 10 分鐘. (21) [Subtitle]: 調味依照個人口味. (22) [Subtitle]: 鍋子稍微傾斜. (23) [Subtitle]: 就慢慢的打碎 (也可使用果汁機). (24) [Subtitle]: 打成這種糊狀. (25) [Slogan]: 完整影片請收看料理123.
